ImageDescription.value: 1.	Photograph of the Beypore Railway Station at Chaliyam, Malabar from the 'Bellew Collection: Photograph album of Surgeon-General Henry Walter Bellew' taken by an unknown photographer in the 1860s. Chaliyam, a few miles south of Calicut on the Kerala coast, was for a period the terminus of the Madras Railway on the west coast. This view shows a two-storeyed brick verandahed building with the roofs of the railway platforms visible in background.
